interactions.prompt: In the orthogonal transfer regularization term (1/2) * sum K_ij * |w_i^T w_j|, what is the mathematical effect of removing the absolute value? Would the model still be penalized for misaligned weight vectors?
interactions.purpose: Understand the mathematical rationale for Ablation 1 — removing torch.abs() to allow negative dot products, confirming this is a meaningful independent ablation

interactions.prompt: If I want to ablate the ancestral transfer entirely from a hierarchical SVM, what is the simplest way to do it while keeping the model architecture the same?
interactions.purpose: Confirm that setting K matrix off-diagonals to zero is the correct way to implement Ablation 2 (removing hierarchical transfer while keeping the diagonal regularization)

interactions.prompt: Can you help me write a matplotlib plot that shows two training loss curves on the same axis, with epoch on x-axis and total loss on y-axis? I want to save it to a file.
interactions.purpose: Generate the comparative loss curve plot for ablation comparison — the save path and axis labels were changed to match the results directory
interactions.student_modification: Changed the save path from 'ablation_loss.png' to 'results/ablation_comparison.png'. Added a title that includes the dataset name and changed the figure size from default to (10, 5).

interactions.prompt: My ablation experiment shows Ablation 2 (no ancestor transfer) converges slower and to a higher final loss than Ablation 1 (no absolute value). How should I interpret this from the perspective of the paper's claims?
interactions.purpose: Reason about the interpretation of the ablation results — specifically why removing the K matrix off-diagonals has a larger effect than removing the absolute value

interactions.prompt: How do I compute and print the final test accuracy for two separate models using sklearn.metrics.accuracy_score on the same test set?
interactions.purpose: Implement the accuracy measurement for both ablated models in the notebook
interactions.student_modification: Integrated the accuracy computation into the existing model evaluation loop rather than writing it as a standalone function.
